items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: And Philip played lead alto sax and clarinet.

ctx.x: I think Jack DeShari played third alto, because George Perkins played tenor. And Philip played lead alto sax and clarinet. And on trumpet? And on bass horn we had a very fine audition by the name of John Pudra. I don't know if he's still in town or whether he's still around or what, but John Pudra was a very fine bass horn player.
There was a composer by that name, but I think he must have been older than that man.
